observations: The page number «XXII» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. L01-L08 end the explanation of the note of O fol. 127v begun on p. XXI (JP2 0025, L26-L41): Merkur stands for Iblīs because Hermes was identified with Hermes Trismegistos and Thoth.

L08: after «Wort1).» a second point stands on the base line, 35 px to the right, as dark and as large as the full stop before it (7 by 6 px, darkest pixel 15); transcribed as printed, see the critical note.

L31: the m of «nämlich» is printed broken, its last arch and stem faint, so that the word looks like «nänılich»; transcribed «nämlich». N03: the italic capital F of «Fēs» and «Fās» is heavier than the rest of the words; transcribed as italics.
Marks not transcribed: a speck at the right of the page number; a small mark, like the corner of a spacing sort, at the upper left of the d of «dem» (L27).

critical_notes.evidence: a second point, printed after the full stop that ends the paragraph, has no function; a raised spacing sort or a point that has slipped in the forme
